findings.title: Legacy completeness reporting repaired
findings.evidence: data_ingestion/data_completeness.py previously joined numeric CGWB codes to state-less weather names, counted weather rows across 1992–2025 and divided by a fixed276 months. It now maps all sources to canonical IDs, counts distinct finite months inside the configured297-month window, includes zero-coverage districts and exposes source diagnostics.

findings.title: 725-versus-716 coverage concern measured
findings.evidence: The crosswalk has 725 canonical IDs and 724 have an unambiguous state-qualified GeoJSON name/alias match. 1 canonical districts lack a matching boundary; they must remain explicit records in APIs even when no polygon can represent them.

findings.title: 166-versus-24 has separate meanings
findings.evidence: The legacy readiness helper's fixed276-month denominator required166 observed months at60%. Serving uses configured dates, quarterly expected monitoring rounds, and a minimum24 actual observations. For2002-01–2026-09:297 calendar months,99 expected rounds and60 observed months at60%. The monthly history model separately requires24 observations spanning36 months. The legacy helper is repaired in this audit.

findings.title: No predictions.csv export exists
findings.evidence: No predictions.csv was present outside scratch test fixtures at inventory time; this is an absent export, not evidence that database predictions are empty. The database audit measures stored predictions separately.

limitations: No new external data were downloaded.
CSV observed/imputed flags and manifests are declarations; raw source publication dates are unavailable.
Scratch CSVs include test fixtures and isolated replays; they are excluded from active source conclusions.
Monthly missing counts describe calendar gaps, not a requirement that quarterly CGWB observations be monthly.
Groundwater outside -10..300m is flagged for review, not silently discarded; artesian negative depths can be valid.
Train/validation/test label and embargo checks are covered by the separate ML evaluation audit.
The .dump is inventoried and hashed; its historical rows are not conflated with current live database tables.
